RPG Maker Forums Original Thread

Tombi provided a png of balloons to put in the system, and a preset code to enter in the balloonParamList, but these presets don't come with values in the "name" value, so should I give them names? Should they be in ' ' quotations or without? Are the names necessary?

But I'm not sure how to use them, what order to use them. Basically I'd just like an example of how the commands should look inside the event. An example project? I'm a visual learner

Thank you! Well it turns out that I was using the MZ version of the plugin instead of MV and it made a difference. I think I figured out how to do it through more trial and error. For MV, it's not necessary to add a Show Balloon Icon command afterwards, it's only the Plugin command that matters. I'll write down how I understand it just in case someone else will find this thread wondering the same as me.
The Show Balloon Icon command only lets you select from up to 15 of the rows of icons, but the plugin comes with 20 rows of icons, and some of the rows contain additional icons.
In order to display one of the additional icons, like the checkmark, you have to declare the row that the checkmark appears in (row 9), and then the 6th icon from that row. Then, the amount of frames it should be displayed (60) and whether it should loop (until a STOP plugin command is used) or play once. Then you can
optionally
set the X and Y position of the balloon. Not declaring the X and Y will just display it above the event. So this would be:
TF_SET_BALLOON 0 9 6 60 true
But it can't be TF_START_BALLOON because that's only for the regular rows of balloons. For some reason.  The difference between START and SET is that SET can be used in combination with LOCATE and STOP.
